name: Bluff House Beach Resort & Marina
brand_truth: The Out Islands' first resort, still a home for boaters on a bluff above White Sound and the Sea of Abaco.
buyer: US couples and families planning months ahead, returning guests, boaters crossing to the Abacos, wedding couples.

direction.lane: P03 Conch pink (shell-white ground, conch only on the pull-quote band, shutter-green CTAs, ink colophon)
direction.type: T08 Warm humanist (Young Serif + Nunito Sans)
direction.why: A storied resort reads best as a magazine feature; the suite chooser lets the reader book the balcony they just read about.

big_idea: Bluff House as a magazine feature about the Out Islands' first resort, with a suite chooser (upper or lower, arrival date, season rate, that suite's photos and 3D tour) that hands off to Cloudbeds.

pitch_line: Your story is the best thing you own: this concept tells it like a magazine and lets the reader book the balcony on the same page.
assumptions: Wix original-size image URLs used (the base of the scaled URLs seen on the site)
Season boundaries as published; dates 26 to 31 October treated as closed
